about: Minimum recall@5 per query language and minimum first-place rate overall for pack_snapshot.py --promote. First place 0.832, recall@5 0.972, German 0.917, and Spanish 0.875 match the current live snapshot: x-08, x-13, and d-22 miss because the expected clip is en-US and the exact-word AND finds no matching words after the English rewrite. latency_budget_ms is the per-request target measured over HTTP (scripts/search-debug.mjs prints timings).
